alex: quick heads-up — trying to onboard kestrel-3b into the eval harness and running into two issues: 1) tokenizer splits phone numbers weirdly, 2) ONNX export + quant path changes logits compared to fp16 export. failing evals on metric mismatch. attaching small logs below.

alex: ```
Eval mismatch: rouge-l drop 0.06 vs baseline
Sample input: 'Call +1-800-555-0123 to reset'
Kestrel fp16 logits[0][:5]: [12.3, -1.2, 0.5, ...]
Kestrel onnx-quant logits[0][:5]: [11.1, -0.8, 0.4, ...]
Diff norm: 1.2 (too high)
```

maria: can you share the tokenizer version and the exact tokenizer config used when converting? phone splits usually point at tokenizer special-casing or extra unicode handling. :eyes:

jing: saw something similar on a different model — the hf tokenizer we used had an extra pre-tokenizer set that splits on `+` and `-`. example tokenization: 
`Phone: +1-800-555-0123` -> [`Phone`, `:`, `+`, `1`, `-`, `800`, `-`, `555`, `-`, `0123`] which breaks numeric spans. that causes chat-template alignment issues (metrics expecting normalized numbers).

alex: conversion path was: transformers -> onnx export -> onnxruntime quantize_dynamic (ORT 1.15 in our local) then we run `onnxruntime==1.18` in CI container. i suspect ORT version drift changes fusions and causes small numeric diffs. export command we used: 
```bash
python -m transformers.onnx --model kestrel-3b ./onnx --opset 17
python -m onnxruntime.quantization.quantize_dynamic model.onnx model.quant.onnx
```

sam: our CI image currently uses `redwood/onnx-runtime:latest` which pulled 1.18 last time. that explains mismatch between local repro (1.15) and CI (1.18). we should pin ORT in the image or in the quant step. i'll open a PR to pin the runtime in CI.

ci-bot: CI job kestrel-onboard-export failed (exit code 1) — see logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/teams/eng-ml/pipelines/531/logs/27

maria: concrete fix proposal: 1) pin `tokenizers==0.13.3` in the eval-runner image, 2) add a chat template normalization step that maps phone-like regexes to a single sentinel token during metric calc, 3) re-run export with matching ORT in local and CI (opset 17). try this command for export reproducibility: 
```bash
pip install tokenizers==0.13.3 onnxruntime==1.15.1
python -m transformers.onnx --model kestrel-3b ./onnx --opset 17
python -m onnxruntime.quantization.quantize_dynamic model.onnx model.quant.onnx --per_channel
```

alex: adding a small repro script to demonstrate tokenization + logits diff locally: 
```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM
import numpy as np

tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('kestrel-3b')
print(tok.tokenize('Call +1-800-555-0123 to reset'))

# run fp16 model and quant onnx and compare softmax outputs (pseudo)
```

jing: temp workaround for eval harness: post-process token sequences before metric computation to merge phone-number spans via regex, e.g. `re.sub(r"\+?\d[\d\-]{7,}", "<PHONE>", text)` — that'll keep metrics stable while we sort tokenizer/export.

sam: i'll open two PRs: 1) pin ORT/tokenizers in the dockerfile, 2) small eval-runner change to normalize phone numbers (as jing suggested). tagging @alex to review the export reproducibility script.

alex: ack, will review. if anyone can reproduce the logits drift with pinned ORT+tokenizers, please paste a minimal numeric diff. :thumbsup:

maria: also adding note — check hidden-state shapes during export; we had an off-by-1 in kv cache axis on a previous model when opset mismatched. worth validating with `onnxruntime-tools` sanity checks before running evals.

sam: PRs opened: #412 (docker pin) and #413 (eval phone normalization). CI will re-run with pinned image tomorrow.

alex: thanks all — will follow up after CI run. :raised_hands:
